subject: bottlenose dolphin
title: This Dolphin Hunts Fish All Day but Never Eats Them

scenes.text: This dolphin hunts fish all day, but never eats them.
His name is Bubbles, a male bottlenose dolphin on Australia's Great Barrier Reef.
He picks out bigeye trevally, fish that grow nearly three feet long, and chases them hard.
Up to ten chases in thirty minutes, until a terrified fish throws up its last meal.
Then Bubbles eats the vomit. Scientists filmed twenty tries. Eleven worked.
He doesn't want the fish. He wants what's inside it.

description:
A male bottlenose dolphin nicknamed Bubbles at Lady Elliot Island, Great Barrier Reef, chases bigeye trevally until they regurgitate, then eats what they bring up.
Filmed from 2021 to 2025, he made 20 recorded attempts and fed on regurgitated food 11 times, with up to 10 chases in 30 minutes.
Genius or just gross?
first_comment: Before a chase, Bubbles clicks and twists his head. Scientists think his sonar may tell him which fish have the fullest stomachs. Would you call that smart?
